title: Slant asymptote by division · Set 2
statement:
Give the slant asymptote of $(x^2+3)/(x-[$a])$ as a function of $x$.

[__________]{a}
hints: Choose a constant that cancels the linear remainder.
solution: The function is $x+[$a]+([$a]^2+3)/(x-[$a])$, so the last term tends to zero.

feedback.message: Choose a constant that cancels the linear remainder.
